request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Black Cart Tinker".

Creative brief
Name: Black Cart Tinker
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A battlefield mechanic that releases rolling wheel hazards from a portable frame.
Body and silhouette: Stooped raider wearing a tool-covered apron and pushing a small two-wheeled wooden frame.
Signature features: Spare iron wheel, hanging hammer, and black-painted cart boards.
Palette and materials: Charred black wood, rusty iron, muted orange cloth, and tan leather.
Movement personality: Busy, calculating, and awkwardly mobile.
Attack concept: Detaches a wheel that rolls in a curved path while releasing four outward-facing nail projectiles at fixed intervals.
Directional details: The tool hammer hangs from the left side of the apron.
Avoid: Steampunk machinery, full-size wagon, modern mechanic clothing.
